summary: Onloc is a self-hosted application designed for real-time location tracking and sharing. It also provides remote control and locking capabilities for lost or stolen mobile devices.
goodFor: This tool suits individuals who require a private infrastructure to monitor device locations without relying on third-party commercial services.
watchOut: The project has a relatively small community and a moderate maintenance velocity, meaning you may need to resolve bugs independently. Additionally, handling continuous location data requires careful consideration of device battery consumption and network availability.
deployNotes: Because the software is distributed via Docker, deployment typically involves managing container volumes for persistent data storage and setting up a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS connections.
